exceptions.card-tone: A card in purple, which means no state, a tinted card in a meaning's hue with its full line (tint), a card outlined on white in any hue (outline, line), and the quiet grey card: brand's card has white and the teal tint only, its status box the four meanings at a 40 % line. The tinted card stays: blind panel 02.11., the highlighted cell as brand's status box scored lower in all five runs (Claude 8:8, 9:8, 8:7; Codex 8.8:8.7, 9.1:9).
exceptions.label-hue: A label in a meaning's, a column's or a speaker's hue (purple, amber, red, green): brand's hw-label with the slide's colour, since brand's label has teal-dark, muted and ink only.
exceptions.callout-status: Amber and green callouts for a risk and a result, their text mixed 40 % into ink for 4.5:1: brand's callout has teal and purple only.
exceptions.code-panel: The code panel is brand's hw-code panel (corner, hairline, colours) with its padding and type set per layout (a terminal's title bar, an annotated line's marker column) and the slide's code ground, night-2 on a night slide: brand's panel sets one padding, the code role's type and the night ground.
exceptions.number-tile: The KPI and number tile: a figure on a square tile, which no other system shows.
exceptions.chart-bars: Chart bars: a slide's data in the slide engine's context and highlight marks.
exceptions.slide-table: The slide table: projected rows at stage size with the slide's own column heads, kept per system.
exceptions.stage-status: The stage strip: the pipeline's stages with the active ones marked, a status no other system shows.
exceptions.frame-tone: The dashed frame in the slide's teal or purple, filled with its tone's tint when active and white otherwise: brand's frame has the border colour and no fill. Its line width and corner are brand's hw-frame.
